c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Academy's Research Institutes
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the research institutes of the Academy of Sciences were reorganised in 2019 and how the change was judged.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.prompt: Say what the government and the leaders of the Academy said about the change, naming the source of each view.
cues: Give the view of the Academy's leaders
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.target: A kormány indoklása szerint a változtatás a hatékonyabb működést szolgálta. Az Akadémia vezetése szerint viszont a javaslat sértette az akadémiai autonómiát.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.english: According to the government's reasoning, the change served more efficient operation. According to the Academy's leadership, however, the proposal violated academic autonomy.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-01.canDo: I can describe how the research institutes of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences were reorganised in 2018–2023, with dates (*kutatóhálózat, autonómia, finanszírozás*).

c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Higher Education Act of 2017
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked about the higher education act of 2017 and Central European University.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.prompt: Say what condition the act set for a foreign university and what the Court of Justice found in 2020.
cues: Give the condition of the act
Give the date and the finding of the Court of Justice
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.target: A külföldi egyetem tovább működhetett, feltéve, hogy a két ország kormánya egyezményt kötött. Az Európai Unió Bírósága 2020. október 6-án kimondta, hogy a magyar szabályozás nem egyeztethető össze az uniós joggal.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.english: The foreign university could go on operating, provided that the governments of the two countries concluded an agreement. On 6 October 2020 the Court of Justice of the European Union held that the Hungarian regulation was not compatible with EU law.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-02.canDo: I can describe the higher education act of 2017 and the dispute about Central European University, with dates (*akkreditáció, egyezmény, kötelezettségszegési eljárás*).

c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Foundation Model
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the government and its critics argued about the university foundations.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.prompt: Say what the government and the critics argued, with minél … annál.
cues: Give the government's argument about funding
Give the critics' argument about the board and the senate
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.target: A kormány szerint minél stabilabb volt a forrás, annál rugalmasabban gazdálkodhattak az egyetemek. A bírálók szerint minél nagyobb lett a kuratórium szerepe, annál kisebb lett a szenátusé.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.english: According to the government, the more stable the funding was, the more flexibly the universities could manage. According to the critics, the greater the role of the board became, the smaller that of the senate became.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-03.canDo: I can describe how state universities came under foundations from 2019, with dates (*kuratórium, szenátus, fenntartó*).

c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Council Decision of 2022
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked what followed from the Council's decision of December 2022.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.prompt: Say what the Council decided, what followed from it, and how the government judged it.
cues: Say what followed for the foundation universities
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.target: A Tanács 2022 decemberében határozatot hozott, és emiatt az alapítványi egyetemek nem köthettek új támogatási megállapodásokat. A kormány szerint az intézkedés politikai indíttatású volt.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.english: In December 2022 the Council took a decision, and because of this the foundation universities could not conclude new grant agreements. According to the government the measure was politically motivated.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-04.canDo: I can describe the dispute about EU funding for the foundation universities in 2022–2025, with dates (*összeférhetetlenség, kötelezettségvállalás, hallgatói mobilitás*).

c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Before the Election of 2026
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.scenario: In a history seminar you are asked how the debate on higher education stood before the election of 2026 and how the election ended.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.prompt: Set the two views against each other, then give the result of the election of 12 April 2026.
cues: Contrast the government's view with the critics' view
Give the result of the election
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.target: A kormány szerint az alapítványi modell stabil forrást adott, a bírálók szerint viszont csökkent az egyetemek autonómiája. 2026. április 12-én a Tisza Párt a 199 mandátumból 141-et szerzett.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.english: According to the government the foundation model gave stable funding, but according to the critics the autonomy of the universities declined. On 12 April 2026 the Tisza Party won 141 of the 199 seats.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-05.canDo: I can sum up the debate on higher education and research before the election of 2026 and the change of government, with dates (*választás, mandátum, miniszterelnök*).

c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Higher Education and Research in Summary
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the seminar you are asked to sum up the period from 2017 to 2026.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.prompt: Sum up the period briefly, with years and sources.
cues: Mention the higher education act of 2017
Mention the research network of 2019 and the critics' view
Mention the election of the prime minister in 2026
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.target: 2017-ben az Országgyűlés módosította a felsőoktatási törvényt. 2019-ben létrejött az Eötvös Loránd Kutatási Hálózat, a bírálók szerint viszont csökkent az Akadémia autonómiája. 2026. május 9-én az Országgyűlés Magyar Pétert választotta miniszterelnökké.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.english: In 2017 the National Assembly amended the higher education act. In 2019 the Eötvös Loránd Research Network was created, but according to the critics the Academy's autonomy declined. On 9 May 2026 the National Assembly elected Péter Magyar prime minister.
c1-tudomanyosszabadsag-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the changes at the Academy of Sciences, at Central European University and in the universities between 2017 and 2026, with years and sources.
